recommendation: Keep the fix. It aligns the current linked ICD detail page and active example with the already-correct Code Systems table and THO without reopening broader ICD terminology policy. If retired artifacts are restored to the build, review their legacy ICD-9 URI examples separately.
issue_request: FHIR-7521 was a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for the DSTU1 terminology systems page asking to sort out the correct URLs for the various ICD-9 versions because the page was confused; Jira records the resolution as approved as edited and cites svn revision 6372.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit e2e7b1ea09020c8286800fc4fc62451eb5df21e7, which replaced the old http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9 table row with ICD-9-CM root, diagnosis, and procedure URI entries. Later history collapsed the local details into ICD guidance, and FHIR-41305 restored the current visible URI column to http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm and http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-10.
additional_context: FHIR-8903 and FHIR-8904 handled the old ICD-9-CM diagnosis URI typo and are already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-20193 and FHIR-41305 are later same-row decisions; FHIR-41305 confirms the current ICD-9-CM URI target. THO 7.1.0 NamingSystem records identify http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm as the preferred URI for active ICD-9-CM diagnosis/procedure code systems. Remaining old sid/icd-9 references are in retired or out-of-build ServiceDefinition, ClinicalAssessment, and ClinicalImpression artifacts.
reconciliation: Changed source/sid-icd-9.html so the title, heading, and URL sentence identify ICD-9-CM and http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm. Changed the active ServiceRequest lipid example coding system to http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm. Published the source-changing reconciliation commit on the combined branch.
source_changes: source/sid-icd-9.html: changed the page title, heading, and URL sentence from ICD-9/http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9 to ICD-9-CM/http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm.
source/servicerequest/servicerequest-example-lipid.xml: changed the active ServiceRequest lipid example diagnosis coding system from http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9 to http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm.
